properties.state: {"decision":"Recorded as BRAINSTORMING, not as a proposal — Alex's observation (v0.47.0, 2026-09-05), in his words: 'Bulk writes are all or nothing, which is correct but costly at scale. One bad enum value is a 21-item batch rejects all 21, so you re-send the whole payload. Fine by design; just expensive when iterating.' He accepts the design; the idea is about the iteration cost. OPTIONS: (a) DRY-RUN / VALIDATE-ONLY — a `check_only: true` flag runs every item through validation and returns the full per-item finding list WITHOUT writing, so a 21-item batch is corrected once and sent once. (b) APPLY-VALID-ON-REQUEST — an explicit `apply_valid: true` writes the items that pass and returns the failures, so the resend is 1 item not 21. (c) NOTHING NEW — the current reply already carries every failure with its INDEX and id (dec:bulk-is-all-or-nothing-with-per-item-findings), so a client CAN resend only the failed item; 'resend the whole payload' is a client habit the reply already makes unnecessary, and the fix may be a sentence in the refusal saying so.","kind":"exploratory","name":"OPEN — a bulk write is all-or-nothing by design, so one bad enum in 21 items means re-sending 21. Should a batch be checkable before it is written, or partially applicable on request?","rationale":"THE STANDING DECISION AND WHY IT STANDS: dec:bulk-is-all-or-nothing-with-per-item-findings — 'a partial bulk write leaves a design in a state nobody chose', and the store's atomic batch makes all-or-nothing free. That argues directly AGAINST (b) as a default and is why (b) here is opt-in only: an explicit request is a chosen state. (a) contradicts nothing — it writes nothing — and is the cheapest honest answer to the iteration cost; its cost is one more flag on the bulk tools. (c) may be the whole answer: 'you re-send the whole payload' is not forced by the tool, and the per-item index exists precisely so it need not be. Worth checking how the refusal is WORDED before building either flag — if it does not say 'resend only these', that sentence is the fix. Ranking is a finding; Anthony rules.","status":"proposed"}
